name: mcp-desk
description: Reads incidents out of the platform team's MCP server, once somebody has allowed it.

incident-desk.name: Incident desk
incident-desk.description: Says what is happening on an incident, out of the incident record itself.
incident-desk.instructions:
Say what is happening on an incident, out of the incident record itself.

Read the incident before you say anything about it. If the connection to the
incident system has not been allowed yet, the run stops and somebody is asked —
that is the expected thing to happen the first time, not a fault, and there is
nothing for you to work around.

Never fill a gap from what you happen to know about outages elsewhere. If the
record does not say something, say that the record does not say it, and name the
incident so whoever reads this can go and look.

may-we-connect.description: Asks a person to allow this desk to open the incident connection.
may-we-connect.says: May we connect this desk to the incident system?

incident-server.description: The platform team's incident system, as they publish it.

incidents.description: The platform team's incident records. Used to read one incident and what has happened on it.

read-incident.description: Read one incident and the timeline of what has happened on it.
